Dear KeHE Deductions,

This is to inform you that we dispute claim R-0000007, which was taken on 2014-06-25. The amount in dispute is $13.20. According to our records, all 12 units of invoice NP1048151 were received, thus there was no shortage. We request the repayment of $13.20. The dispute deadline was 2014-12-22, and this deadline has passed.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
Northfield Pantry Co.
